title: JuControler approved-memory projection
description: Read-only record of Founder memories. Every agent (PM, Worker, QA) receives exactly the active, Founder-approved memories whose scope is global or its own project. Proposed entries, such as QA lessons awaiting approval, are listed but never delivered.

delivery.description: Fixed projection rule. There is no per-role filter and no writable variant.

roles.description: Every harness role receives the same projection. Role is not Runtime.

status.description: Only memories with this status are delivered.

approvedBy.description: Only memories approved by the Founder are delivered.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only permissions. Every field is fixed.

write.description: Must not add, edit, or delete any memory.

approve.description: Must not approve or promote a proposed memory; only the Founder approves.

dispatch.description: Must not dispatch, send to, or control agents, runtimes, or managed work.

scope.description: global reaches every project; project reaches only projectId.

projectId.description: Project Registry projectId for project scope; null for global scope.

origin.description: Who wrote the memory. A qa-lesson stays proposed until the Founder approves it.

approvedBy.description: founder when active; null while proposed.
